name: flow
description: Seth's Claude plugins in two domains, code and work, plus flow, the shared skills both use.

plugins.name: flow
plugins.description: Shared by both domains: frame a task (ambition), settle open questions with a recommended option (decide), write in Seth's style (style), and reflect on past sessions (introspect).

plugins.name: code
plugins.description: Code workflow: board GitHub epics, round up PRs, issues, and agent sessions into one land-and-launch plan, and deliver an item locally through implementer and test-runner subagents.

plugins.name: mcp-servers
plugins.description: For building MCP servers: audits a server's source code against a 48-check best-practices rubric and returns a 0-100 score plus a structured, located change list.

plugins.name: work
plugins.description: Work workflow: set up a task tool of your choice, turn Slack, email, calendar, and meeting notes into action items, delegate them to cloud sessions or a local worker, and sign off on every outward send in one review queue.
